explanation: Data-origin layout refactor: dataOriginLayout.test.ts adds one per-key table (tree, mutability, Cache-Control, Content-Type, purge prefix, WAF admission), the uploader/WAF and pointer-TTL invariants and build-id parsing; queryGeneration.test.ts covers the reader over a temp directory and an in-memory HTTP origin. The purgePrefixForKey, pathAllowed and queryPublicationPrefixes cases moved into that table. Review fix: releaseIdentity.test.ts now checks that every JSON file non-test source imports is a release source, so an extracted publication archive can run verify:release. Test conventions are unchanged.
